project.name: seckill-system
project.description: 高并发秒杀系统 — Spring Boot + Redis Sentinel + MySQL flash sale system with segmented stock, CAS local deduction, and Redis Pipeline batch operations

nodes.name: OrderInfo.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for the seckill order table with id, goodsId, userId, createTime, and status fields supporting pending/paid/cancelled states.

nodes.name: OrderInfo
nodes.summary: JPA @Entity for seckill_orders table with order status constants (pending=0, paid=1, cancelled=2), constructor-based initialization with auto-timestamp.

nodes.name: JwtAuthInterceptor.java
nodes.summary: HandlerInterceptor that extracts and validates JWT tokens from the Authorization header, setting the userId attribute for downstream controllers.

nodes.name: JwtAuthInterceptor
nodes.summary: HandlerInterceptor implementation for Bearer token extraction and JWT validation using JwtUtil, returning 401 JSON on failure.

nodes.name: preHandle
nodes.summary: Validates the Authorization header, parses the JWT via JwtUtil.parseUserId, sets the userId request attribute on success, or returns 401 on failure.

nodes.name: RateLimiterInterceptor.java
nodes.summary: HandlerInterceptor that applies token bucket rate limiting (5000 QPS) to seckill endpoints, returning 429 JSON when throttled.

nodes.name: RateLimiterInterceptor
nodes.summary: HandlerInterceptor with an embedded TokenBucketRateLimiter, returning 429 Too Many Requests when the rate is exceeded.

nodes.name: preHandle
nodes.summary: Checks TokenBucketRateLimiter.tryAcquire; returns true if under limit, or writes a 429 JSON response if throttled.

nodes.name: writeBody
nodes.summary: Writes a JSON error response body via the HttpServletResponse writer.

nodes.name: GoodsMapper.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis Mapper interface for the goods table, providing findAll query method.

nodes.name: GoodsRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Goods entity providing CRUD operations inherited from JpaRepository.

nodes.name: OrderInfoRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository for OrderInfo with custom query methods for finding orders by goods, user, and status.

nodes.name: OrderInfoRepository
nodes.summary: JpaRepository extension providing findByGoodsIdAndUserId, findByGoodsIdOrderByCreateTimeDesc, findByUserIdOrderByCreateTimeDesc, and findByUserIdAndStatusOrderByCreateTimeDesc queries.

nodes.name: OrderCancelScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Scheduled task running every 3 seconds to cancel expired unpaid orders by polling a Redis ZSET delay queue, updating the database and restoring Redis stock.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Redis ZSET as a delay queue with millisecond scores for O(log N) range queries, with CAS-like ZSET removal for at-least-once processing.

nodes.name: OrderCancelScheduler
nodes.summary: Spring @Component with @Scheduled(fixedDelay=3000) method that polls a Redis ZSET for expired orders and processes cancellations with DB update and Redis state restoration.

nodes.name: cancelExpiredOrders
nodes.summary: Polls the Redis CANCEL_ZSET_KEY for expired order members (batch of 20) and delegates to processCancellation for each.

nodes.name: processCancellation
nodes.summary: Parses the ZSET member (goodsId:userId:segment), removes it from ZSET, updates seckill_order status to cancelled in DB via JDBC, restores Redis segmented stock and order set, and clears sold-out marker.

nodes.name: GoodsService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining listGoods and getGoodsDetail contracts for the goods domain.

nodes.name: GoodsService
nodes.summary: Interface with two methods: listGoods() returning all Goods, and getGoodsDetail(Long) returning a detail map with real-time stock.

nodes.name: SeckillService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the seckill domain contracts: executeSeckill, check stock, poll result, list orders, and pay.

nodes.name: SeckillService
nodes.summary: Interface with six methods covering the full seckill lifecycle: purchase execution, stock query, order result polling, recent orders, user order history, and payment.

nodes.name: GoodsServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: GoodsService implementation using the cache-aside pattern with Redis caching, distributed lock for cache rebuild, random TTL jitter, and real-time stock calculation from Redis segments and local cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements cache-aside with distributed lock (SETNX), random TTL jitter to prevent cache stampede, empty cache marker, and retry-on-miss pattern.

nodes.name: GoodsServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Service implementation with cache-aside goods listing, distributed lock for cache rebuild, real-time stock aggregation across Redis segments and local cache, and detail query with live stock calculation.

nodes.name: listGoods
nodes.summary: Cache-aside goods listing: reads from Redis cache with empty-marker support, uses SETNX distributed lock for DB fallback with random TTL jitter, retries after 50ms sleep on lock miss, and falls through to DB on all failures.

nodes.name: getGoodsDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches goods detail by ID from JPA repository and returns a map with id, name, price, initialStock, currentStock, and sold count computed via calcCurrentStock.

nodes.name: calcCurrentStock
nodes.summary: Aggregates real-time stock by summing Redis segmented stock values plus LocalStockCache localRemaining across all segments.

nodes.name: SeckillServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Core seckill service implementation with Bloom filter guard, delayed stock warmup, segmented stock deduction via local CAS cache, Redis pipeline order creation, sold-out fast path, and payment flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-phase seckill: Bloom filter guard, delayed warmup, local CAS stock acquire, Redis pipeline for SADD+LPUSH+ZADD in one RTT, sold-out marker for fast rejection, and ZSET-based order cancellation delay.

nodes.name: SeckillServiceImpl
nodes.summary: SeckillService implementation orchestrating the full flash sale flow with Bloom filter guard, segmented stock routing, local CAS stock acquire with auto-restock, Redis pipeline writes, sold-out fast path, and payment with ownership verification.

nodes.name: executeSeckill
nodes.summary: Core flash sale execution: Bloom filter guard, delayed warmup, segmented stock routing, CAS local stock acquire with auto-restock, Redis pipeline for SADD+LPUSH+ZADD in one RTT, sold-out fast path with TTL marker.

nodes.name: getStock
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated stock by summing Redis segmented stock, local cache remaining, DB fallback, and on-demand warmup if Redis key is missing.

nodes.name: getResult
nodes.summary: Polls order result by querying OrderInfoRepository, checking for cancellation, and fallback membership check in Redis order set.

nodes.name: getRecentOrders
nodes.summary: Returns recent orders for a goods item from the database, limited by configurable count.

nodes.name: getMyOrders
nodes.summary: Returns the authenticated user's orders with optional status filter, enriched with goods names from GoodsRepository.

nodes.name: payOrder
nodes.summary: Processes payment: verifies order ownership and pending status, updates status to paid via JPA save.

nodes.name: warmupStock
nodes.summary: Lazy-loads a goods stock into Redis on first request, populating segmented stock keys and adding to Bloom filter.

nodes.name: SeckillSystemApplication.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot application entry point with database connection check on startup and Redis stock initialization that pre-fills segmented stock and Bloom filter from the goods table.

nodes.name: SeckillSystemApplication
nodes.summary: Main application class annotated with @SpringBootApplication and @EnableScheduling, bootstrapping the seckill system.

nodes.name: checkDatabase
nodes.summary: CommandLineRunner bean that verifies database connectivity on startup, logging connection URL and username.

nodes.name: initStock
nodes.summary: CommandLineRunner bean that initializes Redis segmented stock from the database, pre-fills the Bloom filter with all goods IDs, and warms up the local stock cache.

nodes.name: ApiResponse.java
nodes.summary: Generic API response wrapper with static factory methods for success and failure responses used across all controllers.

nodes.name: BloomFilter.java
nodes.summary: Redis Bitmap-based Bloom filter with 7 hash functions and a 128KB bitmap, preventing cache penetration for non-existent goods IDs.

nodes.name: BloomFilter
nodes.summary: Redis-backed Bloom filter component using Bitmap operations with configurable hash functions to test set membership.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a goods ID to the Bloom filter by computing K hash positions and setting corresponding Redis bitmap bits.

nodes.name: mightContain
nodes.summary: Checks if a goods ID may exist in the Bloom filter; returns false if definitely absent (no false negatives).

nodes.name: initAll
nodes.summary: Batch-initializes the Bloom filter with all existing goods IDs, skipping if the bitmap already exists in Redis.

nodes.name: CacheConstants.java
nodes.summary: Centralized cache key constants and key formatting utilities for Redis stock segments, order sets, sold-out markers, and order cancellation delay queue.

nodes.name: CacheConstants
nodes.summary: Final utility class containing all Redis key prefixes, TTL configurations, segmented stock constants, and static key formatting methods.

nodes.name: LocalStockCache.java
nodes.summary: JVM-level stock cache using AtomicLong CAS operations that wholesales inventory batches from Redis, drastically reducing network round-trips for high-concurrency stock deduction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AtomicLong.compareAndSet for lock-free local deduction and Redis SETNX for distributed restock locking.

nodes.name: LocalStockCache
nodes.summary: ConcurrentHashMap-backed local stock cache with CAS-based acquire, restock-from-Redis via distributed lock, periodic return of unused stock, and TTL-capped cache entries.

nodes.name: acquire
nodes.summary: Atomically deducts one from local AtomicLong stock; when exhausted, acquires a distributed lock, batches from Redis via DECR, and refills local cache.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Rolls back a locally deducted stock unit by incrementing the AtomicLong counter on pipeline failure.

nodes.name: preFill
nodes.summary: Pre-fills local stock cache from Redis for a given segmented stock key using a distributed lock to prevent duplicate restocking.

nodes.name: returnStock
nodes.summary: Returns all local stock for a key back to Redis and resets the local AtomicLong to zero.

nodes.name: returnUnusedStock
nodes.summary: Scheduled task that iterates all local stock entries and returns unused inventory back to Redis for rebalancing.

nodes.name: RedisUtil.java
nodes.summary: Thin utility wrapper around StringRedisTemplate providing convenience methods for common Redis operations like get, set, setIfAbsent, and delete.

nodes.name: RedisUtil
nodes.summary: Spring component wrapping StringRedisTemplate opsForValue() operations with simplified method signatures.

nodes.name: TokenBucketRateLimiter.java
nodes.summary: Thread-safe token bucket rate limiter using ReentrantLock, with nanos-based token refill for per-second rate limiting.

nodes.name: TokenBucketRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Token bucket implementation with configurable rate-per-second, max burst equal to capacity, and lock-based thread safety.

nodes.name: tryAcquire
nodes.summary: Attempts to consume one token from the bucket; refills tokens based on elapsed nanos since last call, returns true if sufficient tokens remain.

nodes.name: WebConfig.java
nodes.summary: Spring MVC configuration that registers JWT authentication and rate limiter interceptors on /seckill/** paths, and redirects root to index.html.

nodes.name: WebConfig
nodes.summary: WebMvcConfigurer implementation setting up interceptors for auth and rate limiting, plus a root-to-index redirect.

nodes.name: addViewControllers
nodes.summary: Redirects the root URL to index.html for SPA support.

nodes.name: addInterceptors
nodes.summary: Registers JwtAuthInterceptor on /seckill/** (excluding /seckill/orders/**) and RateLimiterInterceptor on /seckill/**.

nodes.summary: REST controller exposing GET endpoints for listing all goods and retrieving goods detail by ID.

nodes.summary: Spring @RestController mapped to /goods providing list and detail endpoints with constructor-injected GoodsService.

nodes.name: SeckillController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for all seckill operations including executing a flash sale, checking stock, querying order results, payment, and order history.

nodes.name: SeckillController
nodes.summary: Spring @RestController mapped to /seckill with endpoints for purchase execution, stock queries, results polling, payment, and order listing.

nodes.summary: JPA entity class mapping the goods table with id, name, price, and stock fields.

nodes.summary: JPA @Entity for the goods table with auto-generated ID, name, BigDecimal price, and integer stock.

nodes.name: JwtUtil.java
nodes.summary: JWT token utility providing HMAC-SHA256 token generation and validation with 30-minute expiry for authenticating users across the seckill system.
nodes.languageNotes: Static utility class using JJWT library with immutable SecretKey initialized from a config string on class load.

nodes.name: AuthController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing WebAuthn/Passkey registration, assertion (login), discoverable login, and session check endpoints under /auth, delegating all WebAuthn orchestration to WebAuthnService.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses two ObjectMapper instances: one default, one with NON_NULL inclusion to strip null fields that browser WebAuthn APIs reject.

nodes.name: Credential.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity mapping to the credentials table, storing WebAuthn credential IDs, public keys as BLOB, signature counter, and transports for passkey-based authentication.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jakarta Persistence with a BLOB column for the COSE-format public key and a unique constraint on credential_id for WebAuthn lookup.

nodes.name: User.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity mapping to the users table with minimal fields (id, username, created_at), serving as the user identity model for the passkey registration and login flow.

nodes.name: CredentialRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface for Credential entities providing lookup by userId and credentialId for WebAuthn credential operations.

nodes.name: UserRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entities providing username-based lookup for authentication and registration flows.

nodes.name: CredentialRepositoryAdapter.java
nodes.summary: Adapter implementing Yubico's CredentialRepository interface, bridging WebAuthn library credential lookups to Spring Data JPA repositories for username and credential operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Yubico WebAuthn server library's CredentialRepository SPI, translating between ByteArray credential IDs and base64-url encoded strings stored in JPA.

nodes.name: WebAuthnService.java
nodes.summary: Core WebAuthn service orchestrating the full passkey registration and assertion lifecycle using the Yubico library, with in-memory challenge tracking and scheduled cleanup of expired challenges.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a ConcurrentHashMap for challenge state with a 5-minute TTL, a @Scheduled pruner, and configurable relying-party identity via @Value properties.

nodes.name: JwtUtil
nodes.summary: Utility class holding shared SecretKey and providing static methods for JWT token generation and userId extraction.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Generates a signed JWT token containing the userId as subject with a 30-minute expiration.

nodes.name: parseUserId
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a JWT token, returning the embedded userId or null if the token is invalid or expired.

nodes.name: AuthController
nodes.summary: Spring @RestController mapping all /auth endpoints for passkey registration, login, discoverable authentication, and session management.

nodes.name: registerOptions
nodes.summary: POST /auth/register/options -- initiates WebAuthn credential registration by returning PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions for a given username.

nodes.name: registerVerify
nodes.summary: POST /auth/register/verify -- verifies the authenticator's registration response and returns a JWT token on success.

nodes.name: loginOptions
nodes.summary: POST /auth/login/options -- initiates WebAuthn assertion (login) by returning credential request options for a known username.

nodes.name: loginVerify
nodes.summary: POST /auth/login/verify -- verifies the authenticator's assertion response and returns a JWT token on successful login.

nodes.name: discoverOptions
nodes.summary: POST /auth/discover -- initiates discoverable (passkey-less) WebAuthn assertion, allowing login without a prior username.

nodes.name: discoverVerify
nodes.summary: POST /auth/discover/verify -- verifies discoverable assertion response, extracting userId from the generated JWT token.

nodes.name: currentUser
nodes.summary: GET /auth/me -- validates the Authorization Bearer token and returns the current userId.

nodes.name: testToken
nodes.summary: POST /auth/test-token -- generates a JWT token for a given userId for debugging and integration testing.

nodes.name: Credential
nodes.summary: JPA @Entity mapped to credentials table storing WebAuthn credential metadata including public key, signature counter, and transports.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: JPA @Entity mapped to users table with id, unique username, and creation timestamp for passkey-based user identities.

nodes.name: CredentialRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface extending JpaRepository for Credential entities with lookup by userId and credentialId.

nodes.name: UserRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository interface extending JpaRepository for User entities with username-based lookup.

nodes.name: CredentialRepositoryAdapter
nodes.summary: Implements Yubico's CredentialRepository interface to bridge WebAuthn library credential operations with Spring Data JPA repositories.

nodes.name: getCredentialIdsForUsername
nodes.summary: Retrieves all credential descriptors for a given username, converting stored base64-url credential IDs to PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor objects.

nodes.name: toRegisteredCredential
nodes.summary: Converts a JPA Credential entity into a Yubico RegisteredCredential object for WebAuthn assertion verification.

nodes.name: parseTransports
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated transport string into a set of AuthenticatorTransport enums for credential descriptor construction.

nodes.name: WebAuthnService
nodes.summary: Spring @Service managing the full WebAuthn relying-party lifecycle including registration, assertion, discoverable authentication, challenge state, and periodic challenge pruning.

nodes.name: startRegistration
nodes.summary: Initiates WebAuthn credential registration: validates username uniqueness, creates user identity, builds PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions with resident key and UV requirements, and stores the challenge.

nodes.name: finishRegistration
nodes.summary: Completes WebAuthn registration: validates the challenge, parses the registration response, persists the user and credential, and returns a JWT token.

nodes.name: startAssertion
nodes.summary: Initiates WebAuthn assertion (login): validates the user exists, builds assertion options, and stores the challenge.

nodes.name: finishAssertion
nodes.summary: Completes WebAuthn assertion: validates challenge and response, updates credential counter on success, and returns a JWT token for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: startDiscoverAssertion
nodes.summary: Initiates discoverable WebAuthn assertion (no username required), allowing login using only the passkey resident credential.

nodes.name: finishDiscoverAssertion
nodes.summary: Completes discoverable WebAuthn assertion: validates challenge, extracts username from assertion result, updates credential counter, and returns a JWT token.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central HTTP API layer providing all backend communication for the flash sale frontend, including WebAuthn passkey authentication (register, login, discover) and flash sale business operations (goods listing, seckill execution, stock polling, order management).
nodes.languageNotes: Thin fetch-based API wrapper pattern where all functions delegate to a shared request() helper that manages JWT token injection and ApiError-based error handling.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for the seckill system frontend including Goods, OrderInfo, ApiResponse generics, AuthData, and the PRODUCT_META lookup table mapping product IDs to emoji icons and colors.

nodes.name: useAuth.ts
nodes.summary: Vue composable managing authentication state with login, logout, and reactive isLoggedIn computed, persisting JWT token and username to localStorage.

nodes.name: usePasskey.ts
nodes.summary: Vue composable wrapping WebAuthn passkey operations (register, authenticate with username, discoverable authentication) using @simplewebauthn/browser combined with backend API functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Orchestrates @simplewebauthn/browser startRegistration and startAuthentication with custom API endpoints for credential options and verification.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Core generic HTTP request wrapper that injects JWT Authorization header, handles 401 redirect to login, 429 rate-limit errors, and unwraps the ApiResponse envelope.

nodes.name: registerOptions
nodes.summary: Initiates WebAuthn registration by posting the username to the backend credential creation options endpoint.

nodes.name: registerVerify
nodes.summary: Sends the WebAuthn registration response to the backend for verification and credential storage.

nodes.name: loginOptions
nodes.summary: Fetches WebAuthn authentication options from the backend to initiate passkey login for a given username.

nodes.name: loginVerify
nodes.summary: Submits the WebAuthn authentication response to the backend for signature verification.

nodes.name: discoverOptions
nodes.summary: Fetches discoverable WebAuthn credential options, allowing passkey login without providing a username.

nodes.name: discoverVerify
nodes.summary: Sends discoverable authentication response to the backend for verification.

nodes.name: fetchCurrentUser
nodes.summary: Retrieves the currently authenticated user profile (userId) from the backend.

nodes.name: logout
nodes.summary: Calls the backend logout endpoint to invalidate the current session.

nodes.name: getTestToken
nodes.summary: Development-only endpoint to obtain a test JWT token for a given user ID, bypassing WebAuthn for stress testing.

nodes.name: fetchGoods
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of available flash sale goods from the backend.

nodes.name: fetchGoodsDetail
nodes.summary: Retrieves detailed information for a specific goods item including price, initial and current stock, and quantity sold.

nodes.name: doSeckill
nodes.summary: Executes a flash sale purchase attempt for a given goods item via the standard rate-limited path.

nodes.name: fetchStock
nodes.summary: Polls the current available stock count for a goods item during flash sale.

nodes.name: fetchResult
nodes.summary: Checks the result of a seckill attempt to determine if an order was successfully created.

nodes.name: fetchRecentOrders
nodes.summary: Retrieves recent orders for a specific goods item with configurable result limit.

nodes.name: doSeckillWithToken
nodes.summary: Performs a seckill purchase using a pre-acquired rate-limit token via direct fetch call, bypassing the shared request helper for higher throughput under load testing.

nodes.name: fetchMyOrders
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current user's orders filtered by optional status with configurable page limit via URLSearchParams.

nodes.name: payOrder
nodes.summary: Triggers payment processing for a given order ID via the backend pay endpoint.

nodes.name: ApiError
nodes.summary: Custom Error subclass carrying an HTTP status code for structured API error handling across the frontend.

nodes.name: useAuth
nodes.summary: Vue composable returning reactive token, username, isLoggedIn state along with login and logout action functions with localStorage persistence.

nodes.name: usePasskey
nodes.summary: Vue composable that exposes registerPasskey, authenticateWithPasskey, and authenticateDiscoverable functions, orchestrating WebAuthn browser API calls with backend verification.

nodes.name: App.vue
nodes.summary: Root Vue 3 application shell that renders a router-view outlet for displaying routed page components.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point that bootstraps the Vue 3 app by creating the application instance, registering Vue Router, and mounting to the DOM element with id 'app'.

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose orchestration defining MySQL 8.0 database, Redis 7 with master-replica replication, three Redis Sentinel nodes for quorum-based high-availability failover, and the seckill-system Spring Boot application.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build using Eclipse Temurin 17 JRE to package the Spring Boot application JAR, exposing port 8080 with Asia/Shanghai timezone and docker Spring profile.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build using a production JRE base image without build tooling, relying on a pre-built fat JAR from target/.

nodes.name: mysql
nodes.summary: MySQL 8.0 database service with root and application credentials, persistent volume storage, initialization SQL script, and health check configuration.

nodes.name: redis-master
nodes.summary: Primary Redis 7 node serving as the replication master with custom configuration, persistent data volume, and health check for high-performance caching.

nodes.name: redis-replica
nodes.summary: Redis 7 replica node synchronizing from the master to provide read scalability and standby capacity for failover scenarios.

nodes.name: sentinel-1
nodes.summary: First Redis Sentinel node in the quorum ensemble, monitoring the master-replica pair for automatic failover coordination.

nodes.name: sentinel-2
nodes.summary: Second Redis Sentinel node providing quorum-based consensus for failover decisions, started after sentinel-1 is healthy.

nodes.name: sentinel-3
nodes.summary: Third Redis Sentinel node completing the quorum ensemble for fault-tolerant high-availability monitoring of the Redis cluster.

nodes.name: app
nodes.summary: Spring Boot application container exposing port 8080, built from the Dockerfile, with dependencies on MySQL and all three Sentinel nodes for coordinated startup.

nodes.name: README.md

nodes.name: docker-compose-simple.yml

nodes.languageNotes: Hybrid batch/PowerShell script using the <# : batch portion trick to embed both interpreters in one file.

nodes.name: pom.xml

nodes.name: domain.md

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Begin with the README to understand the seckill-system's purpose: a high-concurrency flash sale platform built on Spring Boot + Redis Sentinel + MySQL. This document describes the 8-layer architecture (Tomcat, Rate Limiter, Controller, Service, LocalStockCache, Redis Pipeline, OrderPersistScheduler, MySQL) and core design decisions like stock segmentation (10 segments), CAS local deduplication, and token bucket rate limiting at 5000 QPS. It provides the mental model needed before exploring any code.

tour.title: System Configuration Foundation
tour.description: The application.yml tunes Tomcat for high concurrency (500 threads, 10K max-connections), configures MySQL via HikariCP (30 pool size), and sets up Redis connection pooling (100 max-active). The pom.xml reveals the full dependency stack: Spring Boot 3.2.5, JPA, Redis, MyBatis, jjwt 0.12.5 for JWT, and Yubico's WebAuthn library for passkey authentication. Together these files define the performance characteristics and capabilities of the system.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point and Initialization
tour.description: SeckillSystemApplication.java is the Spring Boot entry point annotated with @SpringBootApplication. Beyond standard bootstrapping, it performs critical initialization on startup: checking database connectivity, pre-filling Redis segmented stock from the goods table, and warming the Bloom filter. This file sets the stage for understanding how the system prepares for high-concurrency flash sales before accepting any requests.

tour.title: Core Data Models
tour.description: The Goods and OrderInfo JPA entities define the domain model. Goods maps to the product catalog with id, name, price, and stock fields. OrderInfo tracks seckill orders with goodsId, userId, createTime, and a status field supporting pending/paid/cancelled states. These entities form the contract between the service layer, the database, and the API responses throughout the system's request flow.

tour.title: Request Pipeline: Authentication and Rate Limiting
tour.description: WebConfig registers two HandlerInterceptors on /seckill/** paths: JwtAuthInterceptor extracts and validates JWT tokens from the Authorization header, setting the userId for downstream controllers; RateLimiterInterceptor applies token bucket rate limiting (5000 QPS) and returns a 429 JSON response when throttled. This pipeline ensures every seckill request is authenticated and within rate limits before reaching business logic.
tour.languageLesson: Spring HandlerInterceptors operate at the pre-handle stage, running before controller methods. The order of interceptor registration in WebConfig determines execution priority. Returning false from preHandle short-circuits the request, which is how both JWT validation failures and rate limit exceeded responses are handled without reaching the controller.

tour.title: Concurrency Infrastructure: Rate Limiter and Stock Cache
tour.description: Three key infrastructure files power the system's high-concurrency guarantees. TokenBucketRateLimiter uses ReentrantLock with nanos-based token refill for thread-safe per-second rate limiting. LocalStockCache wholesales inventory batches from Redis into AtomicLong-based JVM cache, using CAS operations to drastically reduce network round-trips during stock deduction. CacheConstants centralizes all Redis key patterns for stock segments, order sets, sold-out markers, and the cancellation delay queue, ensuring consistent key formatting across all services.
tour.languageLesson: Java's AtomicLong.compareAndSet (CAS) provides lock-free thread safety on the JVM. When combined with a retry loop, it enables optimistic concurrency: multiple threads race to decrement stock, and only one succeeds per CAS cycle. This avoids synchronized blocks or ReentrantLock contention entirely, which is critical at 5000+ QPS.

tour.title: Cache Penetration Protection and Response Wrapping
tour.description: BloomFilter implements a Redis Bitmap-based filter with 7 hash functions and a 128KB bitmap, serving as a guard against cache penetration for non-existent goods IDs. ApiResponse provides a generic response wrapper with static factory methods for success and failure, used consistently across all controllers. RedisUtil offers a thin convenience wrapper around StringRedisTemplate. These utilities form the shared infrastructure that every service and controller depends on, as evidenced by their high fan-in counts in the dependency graph.

tour.title: Core Flash Sale Engine
tour.description: SeckillServiceImpl is the heart of the system, implementing the seckill domain contracts defined in the SeckillService interface. Its executeSeckill method follows a multi-layered guard pattern: Bloom filter check, sold-out fast path, local CAS cache deduction, Redis pipeline batch order creation, and payment flow. With a fan-out of 9 file dependencies, it orchestrates the entire flash sale transaction. The warmupStock method pre-loads segmented inventory from the database on startup.
tour.languageLesson: The Redis Pipeline pattern batches multiple commands into a single round-trip (1 RTT instead of N). In SeckillServiceImpl, order creation commands are accumulated in a pipeline and flushed atomically, transforming what would be 5+ network calls into a single request to Redis. This is critical for maintaining throughput under high concurrency.

tour.title: Async Order Persistence and Cancellation
tour.description: OrderQueueService provides a Redis-backed FIFO queue for seckill orders using atomic batch dequeue via a Lua script with 10-minute TTL. OrderPersistScheduler dequeues orders every 200ms and batch-inserts them into MySQL, with fallback re-enqueue on failure. OrderCancelScheduler runs every 3 seconds, polling a Redis ZSET delay queue to cancel expired unpaid orders and restore stock. This queue-based persistence architecture decouples the hot write path from database latency.
tour.languageLesson: Redis Lua scripts execute atomically on the server, providing transactional semantics for multi-key operations without network round-trips. The atomic batch dequeue in OrderQueueService uses EVALSHA to run a cached Lua script that pops multiple items from a list in one call, ensuring no order is lost between the check and removal.

tour.title: REST API Layer
tour.description: SeckillController and GoodsController expose the HTTP API surface. GoodsController provides GET endpoints for listing goods and retrieving detail by ID. SeckillController handles the flash sale operations: executing a seckill, checking stock, polling order results, listing orders, and payment. Both controllers return ApiResponse-wrapped results and rely on the interceptors registered in WebConfig for authentication and rate limiting.

tour.title: WebAuthn Passkey Authentication
tour.description: The system uses WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkey authentication for passwordless login. WebAuthnService orchestrates the full registration and assertion lifecycle using the Yubico library, with in-memory challenge tracking and scheduled cleanup of expired challenges. AuthController exposes /auth endpoints for registration, assertion (login), discoverable login, and session checks. The User and Credential JPA entities store identity and public key credentials, while CredentialRepositoryAdapter bridges the Yubico library's credential lookups to Spring Data JPA.
tour.languageLesson: The Adapter pattern bridges two incompatible interfaces. CredentialRepositoryAdapter implements Yubico's CredentialRepository (from the WebAuthn library) while delegating to Spring Data JPA repositories, allowing the WebAuthn library to remain agnostic of the persistence layer. This is a clean separation of concerns typical in Spring Boot applications.

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: The schema defines two core flash sale tables. seckill_goods tracks the remaining stock for each product during a flash sale event. seckill_order records user purchases with a composite unique constraint on (goods_id, user_id) that prevents duplicate flash sale orders at the database level. This constraint provides a last line of defense against overselling even if the application layer has a race condition.
tour.languageLesson: Composite unique constraints in SQL provide row-level deduplication at the database layer. The UNIQUE(goods_id, user_id) constraint ensures that even under concurrent inserts, no user can place two orders for the same flash sale item. This is a defensive pattern that complements application-level deduplication (Bloom filter, CAS cache).

tour.title: Frontend Application Shell
tour.description: The Vue 3 frontend entry point (main.ts) bootstraps the application and mounts it to the DOM. The router configuration defines five routes (seckill, goods-detail, orders, dashboard, login) with a beforeEach navigation guard that enforces authentication. The API layer (api/index.ts) provides all backend communication for passkey authentication and flash sale operations. Together these files form the frontend counterpart to the backend controllers from Step 10.

tour.title: Containerization and Deployment Infrastructure
tour.description: The Dockerfile packages the Spring Boot application into a single-stage JRE 17 container exposing port 8080. Docker Compose orchestrates the full infrastructure: MySQL 8.0, Redis 7 with master-replica replication, three Redis Sentinel nodes for quorum-based automatic failover, and the application container with dependency coordination. The redis.conf uses hybrid RDB+AOF persistence with everysec fsync for balancing performance and data safety, while sentinel.conf configures a 3-node quorum with 5-second down-after-milliseconds timeout.
tour.languageLesson: Redis Sentinel provides high-availability through a quorum-based failover mechanism. With three sentinel nodes and quorum=2, at least two sentinels must agree that the master is down before a failover is triggered. This prevents split-brain scenarios and ensures the application always connects to a healthy master via the sentinel-backed Redis configuration.

tour.title: Performance Validation and Benchmarks
tour.description: The load test report and Architecture Decision Records provide empirical validation of the system's performance characteristics. The stock segmentation ADR documents a 5.6x QPS improvement (from 162/s to 912/s) by distributing Redis Lua contention across 10 stock segments.
